authorization.exactUserAuthorization: 授权正式结果分析、赢家裁决、Phase B

M3.scope: eight main movement conditions at N=128
M3.passPerCondition: allUnitsArrived in at least 45 of 48 complete blocks

M4.scope: eight main M4 conditions at N=128
M4.passPerCondition: median of 48 block P95 frame times <= 0.033333 seconds and at most 3 of 48 block P95 values > 0.050 seconds

M5.scope: all eight main movement conditions at N=128
M5.pass: sum of critical violations equals zero

primaryM1.scope: module A movement lane, C01-C08, N=128
primaryM1.conditionWeighting: equal; each condition contributes the mean of its 48 paired log ratios
primaryM1.standardError: fixed-stratum independent-block variance of the equally weighted condition means
primaryM1.degreesOfFreedom: Welch-Satterthwaite across the eight fixed condition strata
primaryM1.marginalTests: two-sided paired t tests on condition-stratified log ratios
primaryM1.multiplicityTests: Holm step-down adjusted p-values across the six unordered pairs

decisionIntervals.kind: Bonferroni simultaneous two-sided intervals across six pairwise effects
decisionIntervals.reason: A unique rectangular set of marginal Holm confidence intervals is not determined by ordinary Holm-adjusted p-values. The Bonferroni companion intervals provide auditable strong simultaneous coverage and are conservative relative to the frozen no-forced-winner objective.

primaryM1.uniqueWinner: candidate decision-interval upper ratio < 0.95 versus every other eligible algorithm

M2.scope: module A movement lane, C01-C08, N=128
M2.sharedMissingness: include a block only when its common mask is sufficient and all four algorithm means are finite and positive
M2.estimationAndMultiplicity: same condition-stratified paired method, Holm p-values and Bonferroni simultaneous decision intervals as M1
M2.guard: candidate upper ratio <= 1.10 versus every other eligible algorithm
M2.secondaryTieOperationalization: all eligible pairwise M1 decision intervals must lie wholly within [0.95, 1.05]
M2.secondaryWinner: when the tie operationalization holds, candidate M2 upper ratio < 1.00 versus every other eligible algorithm

twoOrMoreEligible: if no unique M1 winner, apply the frozen M1 practical tie and M2 secondary rule
otherwise report NO_UNIQUE_WINNER and retain all eligible candidates

quantityEffects.N128Source: module A observations reused once and not duplicated
quantityEffects.linearModel: outcome ~ intercept + anchor_C07 + log2_N_centered_at_128 + algorithm + algorithm_by_log2_N
quantityEffects.covariance: CR1 cluster-robust sandwich with complete block as cluster
quantityEffects.reportedEffects: per-doubling ratio for each algorithm and algorithm-by-log2(N) interaction ratios with ordinary 95 percent intervals
quantityEffects.selectionRole: descriptive applicability and scaling; winner remains determined at N=128

descriptiveUncertainty.M3Completion: Wilson 95 percent binomial intervals per algorithm and design cell
descriptiveUncertainty.M5CriticalViolation: counts and affected-block counts; no claim of population-zero risk
descriptiveUncertainty.M4Eligibility: observed 48-block median/count gate plus descriptive block summaries

software.studentTImplementation: regularized incomplete beta plus deterministic bisection, validated against frozen known-answer values
